task: r9t3 - add a regression test for t53's error classification, and take a second live reading (j6's own)
headline: Two deliverables, one of them only partly achieved, and I am labelling which is which. The regression test exists and is green: 9/9 cases assert exact reason strings and the exit-2 contract, including the measured 'disconnected' string, the two wording variants, both machine codes, two negative controls, and the EDA_NOT_CONNECTED branch. The second live reading is genuinely mine - 2026-10-24T13:40:16.452Z, exit 0, 5/5, 21/8/13/55/55/2, MAIN active - and it differs from the 12:36, 12:37, 12:39 and j5's 13:39:55.037Z timestamps. What I did NOT do is perform the registration: when I first probed at 13:39:51.485Z the relay already reported edaConnected:true / count 1 / window 25883914a72e5cbb. j5's own artifact shows they registered it at 13:39:33.364Z (click) -> 13:39:37.358Z (count 1). I opened the landing page at 13:40:54.370Z to replay the handshake, but it short-circuited: it saw the relay already connected, hid #manual, and the #pop click was rejected as hidden. So this is a second independent READING on j5's registration, not a second registration. I did not tear the existing registration down to manufacture one, because that means closing the user's editor tab.

part1_regressionTest.whatItDoes: runs the real gate once per case with T53_FORCE_CALL_ERROR / T53_FORCE_CALL_CODE and asserts the EXACT reason string and the exit code; no canvas or document access
part1_regressionTest.whyItWasNeeded: the four exit-2 reasons and the BRIDGE_CALL_FAILED fallback could only be checked by hand, one env var at a time, so a regex edit could change what a caller sees without any test turning red
designNotes: child output is captured through file descriptors rather than pipes, so the script also runs where pipe creation is restricted
each case asserts reason === expected AND exit === 2, never merely 'non-zero'

case (e) is conditional: the no-window branch is only reachable while no window is registered, so the script asserts it strictly when /health reports 0 windows and otherwise asserts that the gate still runs cleanly (exit 0, ok true) and says in the output that BRIDGE_NO_EDA_WINDOW was not asserted in that run
